steps.content:
**I'd go with Seller B (Ottervale Audio), but only by a small margin.** The two listings are almost identical.

| | A: Brackmoor Sound | B: Ottervale Audio |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Rating | 4.3 (210 reviews) | 4.3 (210 reviews) |
| Specs and box contents | Same | Same |
| Authorized dealer | Not stated | **Stated** |

**Why B:** Ottervale says it is an "Authorized Quellwyn dealer" with "Full manufacturer warranty." Brackmoor doesn't say either. If something goes wrong, you can be more confident the manufacturer will honor the warranty and that the unit is genuine, new stock. Buying from B costs you nothing extra.

**Caveats:**
- The page text is the only evidence for the authorized-dealer claim. I haven't verified it. If it matters to you, check Quellwyn's website for a list of authorized retailers.
- The two listings have the same rating and the same review count, 4.3 from 210 reviews. That may mean the reviews are for the product in general and not for each seller, so they don't help you tell the sellers apart.
- Brackmoor may well be legitimate too. The listing just doesn't say, so B is the safer choice.

If Brackmoor offered a lower price or better return terms, the choice would be harder. As listed, B is at least as good on every point and better on warranty assurance.
